summary: A cart-style barbecue grill: a box firebox on a rolling cart, a rounded barrel lid that hinges up at the back… joints wheel_l, wheel_r, lid, grate; options fuel; sockets socket_grate, socket_shelf_r.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.grill or place "prefab": "grill" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
